Source and data contract

Agent operations: VAOS source catalog. Business ledger structure: VYNDI source definitions. This file does not connect to private APIs, authenticate a user, alter ledgers or grant access. Data outputs retain their declared status; loading a file does not independently verify it.

Accepted snapshot: schema: vyndi.neural.snapshot.v1; observedAt; arrays records and outputs. Each record: id, department, ledger, sourceRef, observedAt, fields. Each output: id, title, department, ledger, value (number or null), unit, definition, recordIds, sourceRef, status. Status: reviewed, partial, scenario. Multiple inputs can support a single output; numeric values are supplied, never inferred from mixed ledger fields.
